observations: The desktop writing heading shows the label and both actions clearly, with the existing size action first.
Phone layouts stack the actions above the writing help and field without clipping or overlap.
At 200% text, both action labels wrap clearly and the textarea retains its normal internal scrolling.
Forced-color text, arrows, control outlines, and focus remain visible.
The RTL view preserves the size and return action order and fits the 320-pixel viewport.

independentSourceReview.scope: Normalized tested availability, local target ID/ref, explicit focus/scroll only, first size control, unchanged textarea/help/count/guide position, hidden SVG and scoped responsive/focus/forced-color styles.
